=Founders=

At the [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/LLG+2003+Annual+Meeting+Minutes 2003 Annual General Meeting], the membership created the honorary position of Founder, awarding it to [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/John+Clifford John Clifford],[http://www.lojban.org/tiki/Nora+LeChevalier Nora LeChevalier], [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/Biography+of+Robert+LeChevalier Robert LeChevalier], Jeff Taylor and Tommy Whitlock. The position of founder includes the authorization to sign official communications.
